question: Does a single Yggdrasil model with two independent, actually trainable tokenless action-conditioned predictive representation learners and its original NativeEpisodeExperience improve adaptation to hidden causal shifts while retaining original evidence and cold continuation?

predecessor_negative.result: pooled chronological Brier lagged conditional-count controls on all three CKAD24 seeds; no tuning or rerun with them

source.family: previously consumed, authentic native CKAD37 source-locked synthetic intervention receipts
source.native_cold_source_sha: pilot case.worlds[*].final_state_sha256; recomputed by replay from public rows before any new weights are trained
source.prior_source: CKAD37 PR #1260 qualified at source SHA 60634ab8c46b13039e021f28f8fa70bb6b69db96; pilot receipt first-use previously consumed
source.allowed_features: public_views and actual revealed public_row x1/s2/x2/y only. No phase, world label within learner, private simulator boundary, future event, held answer, oracle selector, or hindsight

architecture.model: One opt-in bundled NativeMultiLearner checkpoint, retaining original NativeEpisodeExperience as authority-free native causal experience subsystem; separate independently learned transition and terminal JEPA-style latent specialists
architecture.teacher: stop-gradient, fixed non-collapsed two-coordinate target: binary 0->[-1,1], 1->[1,-1]. Each specialist predicts latent outcome from public views + relevant actions, not next text token; no pretrained V-JEPA2 weights or video objective.
architecture.input: two projections of paired public views; first action for transition, first and actually revealed s2 and second action for terminal. Separate 8-wide tanh encoders, 2-wide latent predictors, trained online only after observed consequence. Both projections contribute gradient; no privileged stable-coordinate index.
architecture.checkpoint: source-native checkpoint bytes+SHA and both separate trainable weights/step counters, strict validation and cold restore; source replay idempotency and conflicting evidence rejection with no specialist update
architecture.decisions: fixed preregistered blend 75% native stream prediction +25% corresponding JEPA prediction; specialized-only readout measured as secondary
architecture.context: each source world independently has one native stream; begin_stream once after initial 48 receipts, never on hidden A/B/A shifts; latent models never receive phase labels

frozen_training.initial_weight: sin/cos formula based solely on dimensional index and fixed specialist salt
frozen_training.loss: MSE to fixed teacher embedding, both public observations equally; sigmoid(2*(latent0-latent1)) for calibrated probability
frozen_training.regularization: no weight decay, no teacher updates, no reference hidden state
frozen_training.training_order: prequential each actual CKAD37 receipt: predict before source outcome update, observe native once, then train separate encoders only after revealed outcome
frozen_training.episodes_from_original_custody: full 919 across 4 streams, two observed outcomes per episode

controls: Original NativeEpisodeExperience context stream (same authentic source receipts, original CKAD37 recorded forecasts)
Independent fully fitted Beta(1,1) full history; sliding window24; window48; exponential-discount .95; sham .5 (prequential recorded CKAD37 receipts)
Same pair of JEPA specialists trained on intentionally mismatched past-outcome labels, with equal updates, as mechanism-negative control
Native unchanged exact byte state, native-global baseline (recorded), and fixed 0.75/0.25 mixed action-state predictor

evaluation.primary: pooled Brier on late_B + late_return_A episodes, both source worlds per pilot seed; same public source chronological outcomes and phase masks as original CKAD37 (masks evaluator-only)
evaluation.secondary: stable_A, early_B, late_B, early_return_A, late_return_A prequential Brier for blended, JEPA-only, controls; frozen old-world A return; pairing negative; native rederived source bytes SHA and source IDs; final native and specialist cold checkpoint replay; per-phase learner update counts; parent source hash and runtime costs
evaluation.criterion: For each seed, blended pooled late Brier must beat original native_stream by >=0.005 and lowest Brier of conventional 24/48/full/discount by >=0.010; blended early_B and late_return_A must not worsen original native_stream by >0.010. Paired JEPA alone must beat mismatched control by >=0.010 pooled on both seeds. Native state reproduction, source custody, memory cold and duplicate/conflict tests must all PASS.
evaluation.decisions: All predicates must pass DEVELOPMENT_GO. Otherwise DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO; preserve negative. If exact-source/source-ID/checkpoint/guard verification fails, INVALID/engineering failure, not science negative.
evaluation.science: Always SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false: data already used by CKAD37 synthetic pilot and model choice follows previous JEPA negative; no fresh source-world first-use or independent physical-world test.

authority: Isolated Yggdrasil draft development branch, no accepted main, no original source first-use, no model/controller/scheduler replacement, no merge, no pay-per-call API, no deployment, no execution against external models.
